rules.title: Real mathematical driver
rules.requirement: Every decisive visual change is computed from the same mathematical parameter or sample relation named by the narration.

rules.title: One primary question and one scene driver
rules.requirement: The scene performs one learning move from a declared novice state; every major region supports that move instead of becoming a competing lesson.

rules.title: Novice-visible causal chain
rules.requirement: A viewer who knows only the declared prior state can see the evidence, operation, and permitted inference without filling in a hidden mathematical step.

rules.title: Explicit stage ownership
rules.requirement: Every major region has one teaching job and every visible object has a semantic owner; region relationships express the argument before local detail is added.

rules.title: Subtitle safe zone remains clear
rules.requirement: Formulae, labels, braces, axes, and active graphics remain above the reserved subtitle region.

rules.title: Clean entry exit and handoff
rules.requirement: Objects enter when needed, leave when their role ends, and do not leave slow ghosts, stale labels, duplicate owners, or accidental debug shapes.

rules.title: Narration and visual beat alignment
rules.requirement: Each spoken mathematical action appears before or with the corresponding visual action, never several seconds later.

rules.title: Spoken transformation words require measured visual actions
rules.requirement: Every narrated transformation word such as rotate, uniformly scale, reflect, shear, stretch, bend, translate, or zoom is bound to its exact word-alignment anchor and a measured change of the named mathematical object. Repeating or highlighting the spoken words on screen is not action evidence.

rules.title: Screen text has a unique non-narrative visual job
rules.requirement: Every static screen-text payload is inventoried as a formula, object label, axis or tick, parameter value, scene title, comparison label, or transient question with one unique visual job. Explanatory prose that repeats narration or externalizes production intent is forbidden.

rules.title: Every fill and connector has mathematical ownership
rules.requirement: Area fills, bars, arrows, braces, and connectors encode a named quantity or relation and disappear when that relation is no longer active.

rules.title: Motion and eye guidance carry the explanation
rules.requirement: The active object changes at the pace of the explanation, attention follows a declared route, and local refinement adds inspectable mathematics without weakening the global hierarchy.

rules.title: Cross-region relations use disciplined visual routing
rules.requirement: A cross-region relation uses shared motion, temporal synchrony, a compact formula bridge, or a routed local connector; long straight arrows may not cross an active graph or dominate the composition.

rules.title: No production intent on the student-facing stage
rules.requirement: Visible text explains mathematical objects only, never pipeline choices, review policy, creator intent, or engineering workarounds.

rules.title: Formula atoms remain readable
rules.requirement: Formula rows do not overlap, merge unrelated tokens, overflow their region, or become unreadable during transforms.

rules.title: Derivation memory is preserved
rules.requirement: Earlier lines needed by the next inference remain available, token identity persists through transformations, and spoken terms bind to exact formula roles instead of a blindly reused formula slot.

rules.title: Formula typesetting and emphasis preserve rest geometry
rules.requirement: Each displayed equation row is typeset as one expression, aligned by a stable mathematical anchor, and returns to the exact rest baseline, spacing, and bounding box after emphasis.

rules.title: Emphasis is readable throughout its temporal profile
rules.requirement: Formula emphasis uses a legible onset, perceptible hold, and clean recovery; rapidly traced bounding boxes and partial bracket-like intermediate frames are forbidden, and any scale pulse restores exact rest geometry.

rules.title: Stage transitions preserve identity through the midpoint
rules.requirement: Every stage reallocation has a reviewed midpoint where the continuing object remains identifiable and incompatible old and new layouts are not simultaneously presented as complete states.

rules.title: Stage reallocation follows one smooth motion path
rules.requirement: Promotion, demotion, and camera-like reallocation use one continuous path with a perceptible duration and a smooth velocity profile; if midpoint capture requires two segments, their boundary velocities must match and may not stop-start.

rules.title: Major concept actions are clause-locked
rules.requirement: Every major narrated claim has its own cue and visible object change within a tight onset window; one broad cue may not stand in for several distinct conceptual clauses.

rules.title: Limit process is shown as changing mathematical objects
rules.requirement: The viewer sees the finite object, the refining parameter, the intermediate objects, and the limiting object rather than a formula-only replacement.

rules.title: Projection throughline remains explicit
rules.requirement: The scene visibly connects basis selection, inner-product accumulation, and the resulting coordinate or coordinate density.

rules.title: Reconstruction is computed, not imitated
rules.requirement: Visible partial reconstructions come from the displayed coefficients, basis functions, bandwidth, or selector kernel; arbitrary interpolation is forbidden.

rules.title: Active graph protected region
rules.requirement: Formula panels and annotations reserve their own space and do not cover the active curve, samples, axes, local construction, or frequency cells.

rules.title: Complex quantities keep their complex semantics
rules.requirement: Complex exponentials, phases, conjugates, and accumulations are represented by true phase/vector relations, not silently replaced with a cosine or unsigned area.

rules.title: Historical precedent is inspected, not copied blindly
rules.requirement: The scene plan records a reuse, adaptation, rejection, or no-fit decision for retrieved live-history candidates and checks their mathematical identity and review status.

rules.title: Narration remains novice-clear and style-bound
rules.requirement: Scene-local narration follows the main-agent language-style contract, remains understandable as audio alone, introduces each abstraction only after its need, assigns causal responsibility to the correct mathematical object, and avoids production-route or visual-obviousness prose.

rules.title: Scene-local speech media is exact and aligned
rules.requirement: The frozen scene includes fully listened audio, an exact normalized ASR transcript, reader subtitles, word-level timing, and a local timeline whose duration and clause anchors match the audio within the enforced tolerance.

rules.title: Review evidence is artifact-bound
rules.requirement: The review submission references the manifest hash for the exact source, timeline, audio, SRT, audit, QC, and review MP4 it judged.

rules.title: Blind novice review precedes standards review
rules.requirement: The independent reviewer records confusion, visible causality, and eye guidance from the MP4 before seeing the profile and source.

rules.title: Blind reviewer completes a teach-back and prediction probe
rules.requirement: A clear blind pass includes a one-sentence causal teach-back, a concrete prediction under the scene driver, and an explicit statement that no confusion point remained.
